I sat down with Jaylen from Violoop to talk about their new plug-in AI device that works alongside you on your computer. We talked about how it can learn how you work, help with repetitive tasks, handle workflows across different apps, and even keep working while you're away from your computer. We also got into privacy, on-device AI, business use cases, and how AI like this could change the way we work. This episode is sponsored by Violoop.

Enjoy!
